patch.summary:
Choose 8x8 only if your buying job matches “Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24” rather than ManyChat's shape. Choose ManyChat only if your buying job matches “Messenger / Instagram / WhatsApp marketing chatbot — Free 25 Active Contacts; Essential fr” rather than 8x8's shape. Workflow advantage: 8x8 leans business-phone, sales-calling; ManyChat leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: 8x8 is Global UCaaS + contact-centre platform (8x8 Work / X Series) — Work X2 research floor ~$24/user/month annual; CC tiers custom/higher.; ManyChat is Messenger / Instagram / WhatsApp marketing chatbot — Free 25 Active Contacts; Essential from $14/mo annual; Pro $29/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: 8x8 (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs ManyChat (solo, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: 8x8-leaning business-phone, sales-calling, contact-center vs ManyChat-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: 8x8 — Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; ManyChat — Marketing chatbot posture — thinner support-desk / omnichannel agent ops than respond.io.

Limitations — 8x8: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated; Mandatory regulatory/service fees frequently sit on top of list seats; ManyChat: Marketing chatbot posture — thinner support-desk / omnichannel agent ops than respond.io; WhatsApp and multi-channel depth gated to Pro+ on the new model.

Poor-fit cases: 8x8 is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Published seat floors are medium confidence — first-party pricing often bot/quote gated · ManyChat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Marketing chatbot posture — thinner support-desk / omnichannel agent ops than respond.io · Avoid 8x8 if you actually need ManyChat's motion (Messenger / Instagram / WhatsApp marketing chatbot — Free 25 Active Contacts; Es)
